title: AI-Based System for Assessing Health and Moisture Content of Concrete
summary: MUST is developing image and sensor models for concrete cracks and moisture. Field maintenance, safety, and material-saving benefits remain intended.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: MUST is developing and validating image and sensor models for concrete cracks and moisture. Field maintenance, safety, and material-saving benefits remain intended.
purpose: Identify concrete damage and moisture problems through non-destructive monitoring.

ratings.reason: Construction and maintenance organizations are intended to improve inspection and maintenance decisions.
Safer infrastructure and lower material waste are intended outcomes, with no observed field benefit.

ai_role.statement: The account does not separately assess AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 12: AI-Based System for Assessing Health and Moisture Content of Concrete

produced_by: The account does not separately establish the conditions responsible for the benefit.
must_hold: Annotated concrete images and moisture/structural sensor data

headline: AI sensors assess concrete condition
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
